description: the solstone app for windows takes in what you share with it from your screen, system audio, and any microphone you choose. it prepares local, owner-controlled segments for your journal. no telemetry.
notes: this is a portable install: the built-in updater does nothing here, so updates come from Scoop. run 'scoop update solstone' for new versions.
your local segments live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Solstone and are preserved across Scoop updates.
